query: SELECT CASE WHEN street IS NULL THEN 'NULL' WHEN street = '' THEN 'EMPTY' WHEN street = 'NULL' THEN 'STRING_NULL' ELSE 'HAS_STREET' END as street_status, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active' GROUP BY street_status;
